prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile Discourse forum overview for SanForum.at, portrait 390:844 viewport rendered at high resolution, edge to edge with crisp readable German text, no physical device or browser around it. This is a rescue-service community where members browse categories and catch up on discussions. Render the familiar Discourse approach at excellent craft, without introducing a new visual metaphor.

Use the attached image as the exact SanForum logo; preserve its proportions and original artwork on a contrasting deep-blue header. The existing light blue accent is #3877E5 and dark accent #1F7BC1. Use a white reading surface, navy text, subtle cool-gray dividers and a normal UI sans.

Show a conventional mobile header with menu, logo, search and account. Give “Kategorien” and “Aktuell” equal prominence using standard navigation. Include a concise category section with “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung” and “Geräte, Fahrzeuge & Technik”, followed by recent topics “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung” and “Monitoring im Vergleich”. Show standard category context, reply count and recent activity metadata, one unmistakable unread indicator, and a “Neues Thema” button. All illustrative activity counts are sample data; include a small “Beispielansicht” label. Keep category access and recent discussion simultaneously visible in the first viewport. Finish the screen with the beginning of the next topic row. No marketing hero, invented health claims, private names, custom bottom navigation or decorative illustrations.
revisionPrompt: Refine this mobile SanForum forum concept. Keep the overall familiar Discourse layout, existing logo artwork and blue accents. Replace the three large colorful category icon squares with tiny ordinary category markers. Make each category a compact text row with its name and count, without multi-line descriptions, so category browsing and recent topics share the first screen evenly. Reduce the tall header while preserving readable original logo proportions, menu, search and account. Keep “Kategorien” and “Aktuell” equally prominent, the real topic titles, the unread indicator and “Neues Thema”. Add a clearly readable small “Beispielansicht · Beispieldaten” label below the tabs to identify all illustrative counts and excerpts. Keep clean white surfaces, navy text, standard sans UI typography and the same 390:844 portrait viewport. Do not add any new category, feature, decorative illustration or control. The attached original logo is an immutable brand reference.
